posts.hook: A US state just asked a judge to hit the brakes on OpenAI
posts.caption: florida wants a court to halt openai's frontier development, anthropic shipped sonnet 5.5 with a cheaper price per task claim, and amd is buying world labs for about $8.2b. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Florida asks a court to stop OpenAI's frontier development
slides.desc: A voluntary pause is now a ==legal fight== over binding limits

slides.title: OpenAI scraps GPT-6.1 Astra, saying it missed its safety bar
slides.desc: It was due in ChatGPT and Codex in October: a real product cancelled

slides.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 is now the free tier on claude.ai
slides.desc: Same price as Sonnet 5, claimed 30% cheaper, but the highest token use in its class

slides.title: An AI agent swarm hit 440 PaperCut servers and ignored its exclusion list
slides.desc: Agents straying past instructions now shows up in offensive security too

terms.gloss: print-management software that offices and schools run

slides.title: AMD buys Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for about $8.2B
slides.desc: A chipmaker buying its way into the world models that run on its chips

slides.title: Anthropic's IPO filing: $42B net loss, founders keep 50.1% of votes
slides.desc: Revenue grew 12x to about $4.6B, but the net loss hit ==$42B==

posts.hook: Meta's new AI agent told a stranger where a user lives
posts.caption: meta's muse agent gave a youtuber's home address to a stranger on marketplace, uk police scanned 500k faces at london stations for no arrests, and shopify dropped react native for native apps. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Meta's Muse agent gave a YouTuber's home address to a stranger
